speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (a) whether the Ministry has conducted a strategic review of the decision to relocate Paya Lebar Air Base in light of recent global conflicts demonstrating the vulnerability of concentrated air assets to mass drone attacks and long-range munitions; and (b) whether such consolidation of the RSAF’s assets into fewer air bases significantly increases operational risks during a first-strike scenario.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Even then, we may not be able to prevent all threats from reaching our shores.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We have undertaken a series of additional measures to manage the risks and challenges.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Enhancements are also being made in other parts of the SAF.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: For good reason which Members will appreciate, many of our efforts are conducted out of the public eye and not disclosed.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will make public announcements at appropriate junctures should there be good operational and deterrence reasons to do so.

speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
text: Eleven days ago, the United States (US) conducted "Operation Absolute Resolve" in Venezuela.

speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
text: In two-and-a-half hours, the US forces struck four air bases with Kamikaze drones, destroyed Venezuela's Russian-supplied Buk-M2E air defences and eliminated aircraft on the ground.

speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
text: By 2030, I believe these sorts of capabilities will become more widely distributed.

speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
text: So, what is the Ministry's assessment of our post-2030 posture's survivability against this type of strike?

speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat (Aljunied)
text: And does the Ministry believe that there are concentration risks to be mitigated?

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: And I think I will not need to go into details on how we execute our operational concepts.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: My second comment is in response to, not just Mr Kenneth Tiong's, but I sense many other Members' interest in the latest evolving technologies on the battlefield.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: It is something that we have been looking at for many years, even since I was an active member of the SAF.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: Maybe to illustrate this point, I will just share a little vignette which Members may be aware of.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: In 2017's National Day Parade (NDP) – I wonder whether Members will remember the 2017 NDP – many people were impressed by the SAF's dynamic display.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: The most memorable scene from the 2017 National Day Display was the final act towards the end of the parade and ceremony, where we had our fireworks.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: Members may recall there was a display put up where we had 300 drones in the sky performing and forming a heart shape.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: To many, this was a wonderful conclusion to a very nice NDP.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: To the informed observers who are in this line of business, we already knew what that meant for the nature of warfare.
